description: Full detail for one Harris County (TX) civil case by its cause number (e.g. "202662585"): case type, status, filing and judgment dates, the style, both sides' attorneys with State Bar numbers, and every party on the case — plaintiffs, defendants, intervenors, registered agents — which the case index alone does not carry. Party locations are city and state. Use after harris_civil_search_party returns a case_number.

case_number.description: The cause number as published by the District Clerk, e.g. "202662585". A few carry a trailing letter for severed matters.

name: harris_civil_case
